topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I have to admit, when I found out the surprise party was called off, I wasn’t too disappointed. I’ve never been one for big gatherings anyway. The thought of everyone trying to act surprised, the forced excitement—it just seems a bit much. I much prefer genuine moments, like a quiet dinner with close friends or a heartfelt conversation over coffee. Maybe this gives me a chance to plan something that’s more my style, something more meaningful. I’ve already started thinking about what that could be. After all, it’s the thought that counts, and I’ve got some good ideas brewing.
